	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no

	price = price:oe_wp35_bri_gold_price
	price_modifier = {

			desc = "OE_WP35_BRI_PRICE_FACTORY"
			value = oe_wp35_bri_factory_price_value
		}
	}
	payee = scope:recipient

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 6
	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1337
		oe_wp35_bri_participant = yes
		oe_wp35_bri_unlocked = { FLAG = oe_wp35_bri_company_unlocked }
		NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_bri_factory_grant }
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_wp35_bri_participant = yes
			oe_wp35_bri_unlocked = { FLAG = oe_wp35_bri_company_unlocked }
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_bri_factory_grant }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "oe_wp35_bri_choose_seller"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_wp35_bri_no_sellers"
		default_sort = will
		column = {
			data = country_diplomacy_info_trade
		}
		ai_interaction_source_list = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					exists = capital
					capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
				}
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		visible = {
			oe_wp35_bri_eligible_seller = yes
		}
		enabled = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_wp35_bri_seller_has_coastal_land_tt
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					is_coastal = yes
					sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
					controller ?= root
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = recipient
		source_flags = only_actual_locations
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_wp35_bri_choose_coastal_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_wp35_bri_no_coastal_locations"

		pre_evaluation_sort_value = {
			value = oe_wp35_bri_location_factor_value

			}

			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_location_granted_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				scope:target = { oe_wp35_bri_transfer_location = yes }

				multiply = 10
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:actor = { oe_wp35_bri_oe_wp35_is_british_india = yes } }
				add = 20
			}
		}
	}

oe_wp35_bri_bombay_lease = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no

	price = price:oe_wp35_bri_gold_price
	price_modifier = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_WP35_BRI_PRICE_BOMBAY"
			value = oe_wp35_bri_bombay_price_value
		}
	}
	payee = scope:recipient

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 3
	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1337
		oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes
		has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_company_unlocked
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_bombay_leased }
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes
			has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_company_unlocked
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_bombay_leased }
		}
	}

	allow = {
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "oe_wp35_bri_choose_portugal"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_wp35_bri_no_bombay"
		column = {
			data = country_diplomacy_info_trade
		}
		ai_interaction_source_list = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:POR }
				c:POR = { add_to_list = source }
			}
		}
		visible = {
			tag = POR
			location:bombay = {
				owner ?= prev
				controller ?= prev
				is_capital = no
			}
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = recipient
		source_flags = only_actual_locations
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_wp35_bri_choose_grant_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_wp35_bri_no_bombay"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		column = {
			data = population
		}
		visible = {
			this = location:bombay
		}
		map_color = {
			value = oe_wp35_bri_presidency_color
		}
		only_color_selectable = yes
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_location_granted_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				scope:target = { oe_wp35_bri_transfer_location = yes }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_truce_with = {
					target = scope:recipient
					years = 5
					mutual = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_select_location_tt
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_seller_is_paid_tt
		custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_grant_once_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:actor = { set_variable = oe_wp35_bri_bombay_leased }
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:actor = {
				oe_wp35_bri_add_ai_reject_cooldown = { TYPE = oe_wp35_bri_bombay_lease }
			}
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = 30
		opinion = 0.2
		actor_is_rival = -100
		recipient_is_rival = -100
	}
	accept = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_trust = { modifier = trust_treaty_of_windsor target = scope:actor } }
					scope:actor = { has_trust = { modifier = trust_treaty_of_windsor target = scope:recipient } }
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WP35_BRI_TREATY_OF_WINDSOR"
				value = 30
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_bri_bombay_lease }
					gold >= {
						value = oe_wp35_bri_bombay_price_value
						add = oe_wp35_bri_ai_reserve_value
					}
				}
				"scope:actor.country_interaction_acceptance(country_interaction:oe_wp35_bri_bombay_lease|scope:recipient)" > 0
			}
			add = 100
		}
	}
}

		none_available_msg_key = "oe_wp35_bri_no_sellers"
		default_sort = will
		column = {
			data = country_diplomacy_info_trade
		}
		ai_interaction_source_list = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					exists = capital
					capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
				}
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		visible = {
			oe_wp35_bri_eligible_seller = yes
			any_owned_location = { oe_wp35_bri_calcutta_candidate = yes }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		source = recipient
		source_flags = only_actual_locations
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_wp35_bri_choose_grant_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_wp35_bri_no_coastal_locations"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		column = {
			data = rank
		}
		column = {
			data = population
		}
		visible = {
			owner ?= scope:recipient
			oe_wp35_bri_calcutta_candidate = yes
		}
		map_color = {
			value = oe_wp35_bri_presidency_color
		}
		only_color_selectable = yes
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_location_granted_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				scope:target = { oe_wp35_bri_transfer_location = yes }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_truce_with = {
					target = scope:recipient
					years = 5
					mutual = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_select_location_tt
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_seller_is_paid_tt
		custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_grant_once_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:actor = { set_variable = oe_wp35_bri_calcutta_purchased }
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:actor = {
				oe_wp35_bri_add_ai_reject_cooldown = { TYPE = oe_wp35_bri_purchase_of_calcutta }
			}
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = 50
		opinion = 0.1
		actor_is_rival = -100
		recipient_is_rival = -100
	}
	accept = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_WP35_BRI_COMPANY_GOLD"
			value = 20
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:target
				scope:actor = {
					NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_bri_purchase_of_calcutta }
					gold >= {
						value = oe_wp35_bri_calcutta_price_value
						add = oe_wp35_bri_ai_reserve_value
					}
				}
				"scope:actor.country_interaction_acceptance(country_interaction:oe_wp35_bri_purchase_of_calcutta|scope:recipient)" > 0
			}
			add = 100
		}
	}
}

oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no

	price = price:oe_wp35_bri_gold_price
	price_modifier = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_WP35_BRI_PRICE_SUBSIDIARY"
			value = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_price_value
		}
	}
	payee = scope:recipient

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 12
	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		current_year >= 1337
		oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes
		has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_securing_unlocked
		NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance }
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_wp35_bri_is_britain = yes
			has_variable = oe_wp35_bri_securing_unlocked
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "oe_wp35_bri_choose_ally"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_wp35_bri_no_allies"
		default_sort = will
		column = {
			data = country_diplomacy_info
		}
		ai_interaction_source_list = {
			every_country = {
				limit = {
					exists = capital
					capital.sub_continent = sub_continent:south_asia
					is_subject = no
				}
				add_to_list = source
			}
		}
		visible = {
			oe_wp35_bri_eligible_seller = yes
			is_subject = no
		}
		enabled = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_wp35_bri_ally_smaller_tt
				num_locations < scope:actor.num_locations
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_wp35_bri_ally_size_cap_tt
				num_locations <= 60
			}
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_wp35_bri_ally_not_fighting_our_subjects_tt
				NOT = { scope:actor = { any_subject = { is_at_war_with = root } } }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance_effect_tt
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:recipient = {
				make_subject_of = {
					target = scope:actor
					type = subject_type:vassal
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_seller_is_paid_tt
		scope:actor = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance_cooldown_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				oe_wp35_bri_add_cooldown = { TYPE = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance BRITAIN_YEARS = 10 COMPANY_YEARS = 10 }
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:actor = {
				oe_wp35_bri_add_ai_reject_cooldown = { TYPE = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance }
			}
		}
	}

	diplo_chance = {
		base = 0
		opinion = 0.2
		actor_is_rival = -100
		recipient_is_rival = -100
	}
	accept = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { at_war = yes } }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WP35_BRI_SUBSIDIARY_AT_WAR"
				value = 40
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					any_neighbor_country = {
						oe_wp35_bri_participant = no
						num_locations >= {
							value = scope:recipient.num_locations
							multiply = 2
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WP35_BRI_SUBSIDIARY_THREATENED"
				value = 30
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { oe_wp35_bri_historical_subsidiary = yes } }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WP35_BRI_SUBSIDIARY_HISTORICAL"
				value = 20
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { num_locations > 30 } }
			add = {
				desc = "OE_WP35_BRI_SUBSIDIARY_TOO_LARGE"
				value = -30
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					gold >= {
						value = oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_price_value
						add = oe_wp35_bri_ai_reserve_value
					}
				}
				"scope:actor.country_interaction_acceptance(country_interaction:oe_wp35_bri_subsidiary_alliance|scope:recipient)" > 0
			}
			add = 10
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { oe_wp35_bri_historical_subsidiary = yes } }
				add = 60
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_neighbor_of = scope:actor } }
				add = 20
			}
		}
	}
}
